map.输入测量眼压与中央角膜厚度(CCT)，估算真实眼压并评估角膜厚度对读数的影响。: Enter the measured intraocular pressure and central corneal thickness (CCT) to estimate the true IOP and assess the effect of corneal thickness on the reading.
map.同时给 Ehlers/Doughty/Feltgen 与比值法四种校正并取均值。: Gives all four corrections, Ehlers, Doughty, Feltgen and the ratio method, and averages them.
map.厚/薄角膜 Goldmann 眼压的系统偏差修正。: Systematic bias correction of Goldmann IOP for thick or thin corneas.
map.：Ehlers=18+(520−600)×0.071=12.32（厚角膜显著高估: : Ehlers = 18 + (520-600)*0.071 = 12.32 (a thick cornea markedly overestimates; the corrected value is much lower).
map.四公式差异大说明什么？: What does a large difference among the four formulas mean?
map.CCT 偏离均值越远、各经验系数差异越大，均值可减低单一公式偏差。: The further CCT deviates from the mean and the more the empirical coefficients differ, the more averaging reduces the bias of a single formula.
map.校正后能替代真实眼压吗？: Can the corrected value replace the true intraocular pressure?
map.不能，仅为估计；应以多次测量与临床综合判断为准。: No, it is only an estimate; rely on repeated measurements and comprehensive clinical judgment.
